placements.why: Initializes the Calibration strata tier to organize records, standards, and procedures governing instrument calibration and reference verification.
placements.title: Systematic calibration and baseline verification of observatory instrumentation
placements.frame: How are observatory instruments calibrated, benchmarked, and maintained against baseline reference standards?

placements.title: Spectrograph calibration requires full-band verification against historical reference plate baselines
placements.frame: How is spectrograph calibration validated across observing bands against established reference standards?
placements.why: Quill's assertion of spectrograph calibration at 88.4 MHz validated against June reference plates (src-2) and Xena's structured summary (src-3) establish the ongoing discipline of validating instrument calibration across observing bands against fixed baseline standards.
